notes.title: New Release Date
notes.notes:
As you already noticed, the release of the game was delayed until June 15th. In this way, we would like to express support to all protesters against racism.

Although we are from Russia, such concepts as equality and justice are not alien to us.

We decided to add George Floyd to our game to perpetuate his memory forever.
#blacklivesmatter
